note: Every source here was fetched without a login on 4 Nov 2026 and returned readable content. Amazon's Seller Central help pages (sellercentral.amazon.com/help/...) do NOT qualify: unauthenticated they return the 171 KB sign-in shell, so a watcher would hash a login page and report silence forever. Do not add them. The `expect` field is the guard: when it stops appearing, the run reports the source as unreadable instead of unchanged.

sources.label: Selling Partner API changelog
sources.why: Amazon's own dated release notes. Listing attribute rules, order and fulfilment changes, and new policy-driven fields appear here before most sellers hear about them.

sources.label: Amazon news for small business
sources.why: Seller-facing announcements published by Amazon itself. Roughly a dozen a year, so an item is worth reading.

sources.label: Amazon policy news and views
sources.why: Corporate policy positions, mostly not seller rules. Kept at digest tier so it never interrupts; the review step decides whether an item matters to sellers.

sources.label: Sell on Amazon pricing and fees
sources.why: The public fee page. A change here is material to every seller's numbers, and it is the kind of change Amazon does not always announce.

sources.label: Amazon Selling Partner blog
sources.why: New seller-facing posts. Link-set comparison means layout churn cannot fake an update.
